summary: Applicable footprint checks bind declared commands to executable owners. Native receipts, local verification, required CI and accepted Review establish candidate-specific execution and assertion adequacy without worker-job binding. Required continuity obligations remain unproved until checked bindings, passing execution and independent Review establish them. Existing proof, subject, refinement and Review gates keep their owners; no new receipt system or automatic footprint refusal is added.
title: Footprint checks bind to executable owners and use existing verification
